Name: Alternative Texture pack for Blue Grass Recolor
Author: OhMyMycroft
Description:
[center][font=Courier New][font=Courier New]This pack turns [color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53298111]collingbe[/url]﻿[/color] trees from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635]Blue Grass Recolor[/url]﻿ into an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ pack, so you can use them with whatever recolour you want.[/font]

[color=#ea9999][size=3]
[color=#ffffff][b][i][size=4][color=#e06666]To install[/color][/size][/i][/b][/color][/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000][u]You need Alternative Textures!!
[/u][/color]Unzip both the framework and this pack in your mod folder.

[b][i][size=4][color=#3d85c6]To uninstall[/color][/size][/i][/b]
Just delete it, all the recoloured trees will revert to basic sprite.
You can have as many AT packs as you like.



This pack contains seasonal textures for plantable [color=#BF9000]Oak[/color] and [color=#e69138]Maple[/color], just like the original mod.
Wild trees will pick up a random textures from the available seasonal pool when they generate.

To change trees sprites at will, you can use the Paint Bucket you buy from Robin.
You can use [color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff]"[/color][color=#e06666][u]Blue Grass[/u][/color][color=#ffffff]"[/color][/color] and "[color=#3d85c6][u]colling[/u][/color]" to search the AT menu ([color=#b6b6b6]useful if you have many AT packs adding textures to the same object[/color]), or you can try using colours: [u]depending on the season[/u] you can try searching for [color=#0000ff]blue[/color], [color=#9900ff]purple[/color], [color=#ff0000]red[/color], [color=#ff00ff]pink[/color] or [color=#00ff00]green[/color]. [u]Not all the colours show up in every season[/u], [color=#999999]there's usually one colour per tree per season.[/color]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9RoDMJ0.png[/img]
You can also prevent a specific texture from appearing in game using [/font][font=Courier New][font=Courier New][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/font] from the title menu, under [u]Alternative Texture[/u] sub-menu.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/99tB5Tp.gif[/img]﻿

[color=#cc4125][size=2][font=Courier New]None of the assets used here are mine, but collingbe's, [u]ask the original mod author if you want to use them[/u].[/font][/size][/color]
[/font][font=Courier New][font=Courier New]Thanks to [/font][/font][font=Courier New][font=Courier New][font=Courier New][font=Courier New][color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53298111]collingbe[/url]﻿ [/color][/font][/font]to let me publish this! [img]https://i.imgur.com/3GI1HVB.gif[/img][/font]
[/font]

[font=Courier New][color=#dd7e6b][size=5]
[color=#6aa84f]Have fun![/color][/size][/color][/font]
